verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS documents APIs, including a data-plane API, chat APIs and SDKs, but nothing in the evidence describes API versioning or a deprecation policy. The "latest" path segment in doc URLs is not evidence of either. Versioned APIs are a fair axis for a cloud streaming service, so absence of evidence is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
